comment: Screenshot specification for VICE COVER STUDIO, round 5 ensemble edition. Captured with Playwright from the app served by serve.ts; every image is a genuine render of the app or of a PNG the app exported, then finished with a gentle unsharp pass.

actions: serve the app and open it in a desktop browser
keep the default Ensemble Poster layout, Vice Sunset grade, gold dividers and chrome caption
export the portrait PNG at 1080x1350 with the app's own export button
save that PNG, scaled to fit the screenshot limits, as the cover image
open the app with the ensemble cover loaded in the live preview
capture the full editor: preview, photo samples, layout and grade chips, caption fields and panel controls
switch to the Vice Classic layout and the Neon Night grade with neon dividers
capture the editor again so the collage flexibility and second grade are visible
export the wide PNG at 1920x1080 with the app's own export button
display that PNG scaled to fit the screenshot limits and capture it untouched
